lines: Appearing from the shadow of the castle gate were the subordinates who had been with Gonza on the mountain the other day.
Gonza's subordinates didn't put up a fight and collapsed to the ground in exhaustion.
This guy is soaking wet... He doesn't seem to have a scratch on him, maybe he got hit by a Ninja Art or something...
Hmhmmm, mystery solved... It means that there's somebody here apart from us and that spear-dude. It must be a ghost♪
Despite the increasingly disturbing situation, Sakura-sensei seemed to be enjoying herself.
Ghosts aside... I'm pretty sure there are other enemies. Hebiko!!!
As expected of Hebiko, she seemed to have sensed my intentions. She quickly used her Beast Jutsu to turn herself into an octopus.
Hebiko could use the power of an octopus. The octopus was a fearsome creature with a variety of special abilities, not to be underestimated.
One of those abilities was that of her suckers. Octopus suckers were high-performance sensors that could also detect odors.
Hebiko quickly scanned the area by twitching her octopus tentacles.
...!! There's someone coming from the darkness ahead!!
Ah, no, it's probably not a ghost or anything like that... It's not like octopuses can sense the supernatural...
Hebiko quickly shot down the comment from Sakura-sensei, who had a gleam in her eyes.
Doesn't mean it has to be human though!
Oh dear, it looks like we have guests again.
As if in response to those words, a bewitching beauty appeared. A faint unearthly aura was swirling around her.
So you weren't fooled by the "illusion" right away. It's so annoying dealing with so many stubborn humans.
Then a beautiful girl with pale skin emerged from the darkness. From her devil wings and horns, it was clear that she wasn't human either.
Demon ladies, what are you doing here?
First, I tried to question them. They didn't necessarily have to be enemies.
What a cute boy. I bet you have great energy☆
How about we kill the girls and suck the energy from the guy?
They're succubi. Female demons who suck the energy out of men.
That meant they would do "stuff" to men to steal their vigor and then turn it into their life energy.
I shook my head. This was not the time to get tempted.
Why are succubi like you in a place like this?
Why do you think? Maybe to meet you?☆
Submit to us and we'll show you pleasures that are out of this world... forever.
Don't worry Hebiko, rather than submitting to others, I prefer to make them submit to me. So let's force our way through!!!
